column1: # Lexeme class `valency`: verbs whose object is not (only) in the accusative. The accusative
# object is the default and is not listed. Rules: `[class:valency=dat]`.
#   dat      a dative object and no accusative object (ich helfe dir, *ich helfe dich)
#   acc      an accusative object is possible as well (ich glaube dir / ich glaube es)
#   gen      a genitive object (wir gedenken der Toten)
#   acc_gen  an accusative person plus a genitive thing (man beschuldigte ihn des Diebstahls)
# Written from own knowledge of German (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
